title: Fixed Three Full Width Rolls and Side Crank Slip Roller
description: One newly authored whole fixed benchtop sheet slip-roller-style exterior. Three complete long parallel smooth cylinders span two thick shaped end cheek frames: two vertically stacked front rollers with an actual narrow empty entry gap, and one distinct rear offset roller. Every full-width roller has a whole through journal rooted into both side heads. Two low cross ties and two finite long mounting feet support the heads. Four complete short adjustment-screw and hand-knob exteriors face forward/backward at the ends, a right side gear-cover exterior encloses the front journal region, and one full offset crank and cylindrical grip project from the lower front axis. A complete left upper bearing-cap exterior with short release-lever appearance is fixed closed. All visible geometry is new; no old roller, upright frame, machine subassembly or material coordinates imported. Not the existing narrow grooved-wheel ring former on one slotted upright, nor the two-roll cloth wringer with draped cloth, feed board and pan. This has three full-width parallel rolls, two separated end cheeks, a rear offset roll and four local adjusters. One whole model zero scenes. Empty unmounted static display only: no sheet, cloth, wire, load, real gear teeth, moving bearing release, cylinder removal, forming process, roller traction, adjustment travel, thread fit, bending capacity, continuous collision-free motion, fabrication, installation, engineering or machine safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
